fact: Nigeria Health Watch reports that Smart Paper Technology, a hybrid paper-to-digital system launched in 2017 by the Ministry of Health with MRCG, Shifo Foundation and US CDC, was piloted at Bundung and Fajikunda and is expanding, with forms scanned and synchronised with DHIS2.
